notes: *the tenth part of an ephah*: rule 29's fronting reading gives the single *the* to the rectum's article, the construct keeping *tenth part*; the competing reading marks the article unrepresented because the ASV writes *an ephah* indefinitely.
*neither* is read as the waw+לֹא fusion of rule 35, which leaves *any* at t051 to the noun under rule 15, while the earlier לֹא takes the *no* the ASV recast onto *oil*.
סֹלֶת heads on *fine*; the competing reading heads on *flour* and is recorded on the unit.
